test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. ;**Childhood'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence describes** two buddies who have known each other since childhood and have gone through school, college, and the army together.
 
• Therefore, the **word that fits best **in this context is** "childhood,"** as **it refers to** the period of their lives when they were young and formed their friendship.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *There were two **childhood **buddies who went through school and college and even joined the army together. War (2)________and they were (3)________in the same unit. One night they were ambushed. Bullets were flying (4)________and out of the darkness came a voice, “Harry, please come and help me”. Harry (5)________recognised that voice of his childhood buddy*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1,** **"childlike,"** describes a characteristic of being innocent or having qualities associated with children.
 
• **Option 2,** **"childish,"** refers to behavior that is immature or typical of children.
 
• **Option 4,** **"child," **refers to a young human being.
 
• **None of these** options **accurately capture** the intended meaning of the sentence, which is to emphasize the long-standing friendship between the two buddies.
